transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before I issue today's vehicle assignments and dispatch board, we need to hold our transport-board huddle as per our daily dispatch routine. Please speak up now with any constraints I need to be aware of before I make the assignments.

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag a load constraint for the communications mast move. I received the corrected dimensions during yesterday's vehicle check, but the revised load sheet hasn't been posted to the dispatch board yet. This means F-7 needs to be assigned to the mast move to the north relay point.
